package postgres

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

var _ repository.PinnedCoursePlanRepository = Store{}

// BYTEA is deliberate: JSONB changes object key order, including the exact
// existing course-fingerprint-v1 normalized context bytes.
func (s Store) GetPlanningInput(ctx context.Context, r domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint, error) {
	actual, e := s.checkPlanningRequestBinding(ctx, r)
	if e != nil {
		return domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint{}, e
	}
	var c domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint
	e = s.readPlanningCheckpoint(ctx, "course_planning_input_checkpoint", r.ID, domain.MaximumPlanningInputCheckpointBytes, &c)
	if e == nil {
		e = c.Validate(actual)
	}
	if e == nil {
		e = c.Validate(r)
	}
	return c, e
}
func (s Store) GetGeneratedCourse(ctx context.Context, r domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.GeneratedCourseCheckpoint, error) {
	input, e := s.GetPlanningInput(ctx, r)
	if e != nil {
		return domain.GeneratedCourseCheckpoint{}, e
	}
	var c domain.GeneratedCourseCheckpoint
	e = s.readPlanningCheckpoint(ctx, "course_planning_generated_checkpoint", r.ID, domain.MaximumGeneratedCoursePayloadBytes+4096, &c)
	if e == nil {
		e = c.Validate(input)
	}
	return c, e
}
func (s Store) GetCourseEnsure(ctx context.Context, r domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.CourseEnsureCheckpoint, error) {
	input, e := s.GetPlanningInput(ctx, r)
	if e != nil {
		return domain.CourseEnsureCheckpoint{}, e
	}
	generated, e := s.GetGeneratedCourse(ctx, r)
	if e != nil {
		return domain.CourseEnsureCheckpoint{}, e
	}
	var c domain.CourseEnsureCheckpoint
	e = s.readPlanningCheckpoint(ctx, "course_planning_ensure_checkpoint", r.ID, domain.MaximumCourseEnsureCheckpointBytes, &c)
	if e == nil {
		e = c.Validate(input, generated)
	}
	return c, e
}
func (s Store) CheckpointPlanningInput(ctx context.Context, r domain.CoursePlanRequest, c domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint, now time.Time) error {
	if c.Validate(r) != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return s.writePlanningCheckpoint(ctx, r, "course_planning_input_checkpoint", c.InputHash, "", c, now)
}
func (s Store) CheckpointGeneratedCourse(ctx context.Context, r domain.CoursePlanRequest, c domain.GeneratedCourseCheckpoint, now time.Time) error {
	input, e := s.GetPlanningInput(ctx, r)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if c.Validate(input) != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return s.writePlanningCheckpoint(ctx, r, "course_planning_generated_checkpoint", c.ArtifactHash, c.InputHash, c, now)
}
func (s Store) CheckpointCourseEnsure(ctx context.Context, r domain.CoursePlanRequest, c domain.CourseEnsureCheckpoint, now time.Time) error {
	input, e := s.GetPlanningInput(ctx, r)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	generated, e := s.GetGeneratedCourse(ctx, r)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if c.Validate(input, generated) != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return s.writePlanningCheckpoint(ctx, r, "course_planning_ensure_checkpoint", c.ReceiptHash, c.ArtifactHash, c, now)
}
func (s Store) checkPlanningRequestBinding(ctx context.Context, r domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	actual, e := s.GetForStudent(ctx, r.StudentID, r.ID)
	if e != nil {
		return actual, e
	}
	a, _ := json.Marshal(actual.Intent)
	b, _ := json.Marshal(r.Intent)
	if actual.RequestHash != r.RequestHash || actual.GoalCode != r.GoalCode || actual.DiagnosticPlanID != r.DiagnosticPlanID || !bytes.Equal(a, b) || (r.Intent.Reason == domain.PlanningReasonReplan && actual.LearningPathID != r.LearningPathID) {
		return actual, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return actual, nil
}
func (s Store) readPlanningCheckpoint(ctx context.Context, table, id string, maximum int, out any) error {
	var raw []byte
	var digest, hash, parent string
	parentExpr := "''::text"
	if table != "course_planning_input_checkpoint" {
		parentExpr = "parent_hash"
	}
	e := s.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, "SELECT payload_bytes,payload_sha256,checkpoint_hash,"+parentExpr+" FROM "+table+" WHERE request_id=$1", id).Scan(&raw, &digest, &hash, &parent)
	if errors.Is(e, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	if hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) != digest {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if e := domain.DecodePlanningCheckpoint(raw, maximum, out); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	switch c := out.(type) {
	case *domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint:
		if c.InputHash != hash {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
	case *domain.GeneratedCourseCheckpoint:
		if c.ArtifactHash != hash || c.InputHash != parent {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
	case *domain.CourseEnsureCheckpoint:
		if c.ReceiptHash != hash || c.ArtifactHash != parent {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
	default:
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return nil
}
func (s Store) writePlanningCheckpoint(ctx context.Context, r domain.CoursePlanRequest, table, hash, parent string, value any, now time.Time) error {
	if now.IsZero() || r.ClaimToken == "" {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	raw, e := json.Marshal(value)
	if e != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	digest := hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	tx, e := s.Pool.Begin(ctx)
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	defer tx.Rollback(ctx)
	actual, e := scanCoursePlan(tx.QueryRow(ctx, "SELECT "+coursePlanColumns+" FROM course_plan_request WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE", r.ID))
	if errors.Is(e, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	a, _ := json.Marshal(actual.Intent)
	b, _ := json.Marshal(r.Intent)
	if actual.StudentID != r.StudentID || actual.RequestHash != r.RequestHash || actual.GoalCode != r.GoalCode || actual.DiagnosticPlanID != r.DiagnosticPlanID || !bytes.Equal(a, b) || (r.Intent.Reason == domain.PlanningReasonReplan && actual.LearningPathID != r.LearningPathID) {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var active bool
	if e = tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COALESCE(status='PLANNING' AND claim_token=$2 AND lease_until>$3 AND lease_until>clock_timestamp(),false) FROM course_plan_request WHERE id=$1`, r.ID, r.ClaimToken, now).Scan(&active); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if !active {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if c, ok := value.(domain.PlanningInputCheckpoint); ok && c.Validate(actual) != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if actual.Status != domain.CoursePlanPlanning || actual.ClaimToken != r.ClaimToken || actual.LeaseUntil == nil || !actual.LeaseUntil.After(now) {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	// An identical byte-for-byte retry succeeds only while this claim is active.
	var stored []byte
	var storedHash string
	e = tx.QueryRow(ctx, "SELECT payload_bytes,checkpoint_hash FROM "+table+" WHERE request_id=$1", r.ID).Scan(&stored, &storedHash)
	if e == nil {
		if !bytes.Equal(stored, raw) || storedHash != hash {
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return tx.Commit(ctx)
	}
	if !errors.Is(e, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return e
	}
	if table == "course_planning_input_checkpoint" {
		_, e = tx.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO course_planning_input_checkpoint(request_id,student_id,request_hash,goal_code,checkpoint_hash,payload_bytes,payload_sha256,write_claim,checkpointed_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9)`, r.ID, r.StudentID, r.RequestHash, r.GoalCode, hash, raw, digest, r.ClaimToken, now)
	} else {
		_, e = tx.Exec(ctx, "INSERT INTO "+table+"(request_id,checkpoint_hash,parent_hash,payload_bytes,payload_sha256,write_claim,checkpointed_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7)", r.ID, hash, parent, raw, digest, r.ClaimToken, now)
	}
	if e != nil {
		return e
	}
	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}
